articles.title: Morocco: Zellij Star
articles.summary: Fine dense speckle of rust, teal and pinkish tan, like crushed mosaic tile under varnish. Reads as a very dark teal-black with a rusty copper dusting, like speckled dark bronze; the cell pattern is gone and only the dusty rust shimmer stays.
articles.what: Every piece chipped to shape by hand from a fired tile and set face-down into the bed. Up close: A dense net of round-ish cells about 6-10 px, each with a dark teal-black centre ringed in rust-copper and outlined with hairline white-pink lines, like fine lace, a sieve or a bubble raft. Cells are uniform and packed with no gaps; the copper glows a little denser in some 150 px areas. From a distance: Reads as a very dark teal-black with a rusty copper dusting, like speckled dark bronze; the cell pattern is gone and only the dusty rust shimmer stays. Measured spec (average): metal 47, roughness 136, coat 112. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: low. It brings its own colours.
when: Best on: body, sides, hero panel.
Fits: gt / sports car, show car, open wheel.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Morocco: Zellij Star" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Leave BASE COLOR on Use finish's own color to keep its colours.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Whole body: even fine texture works on every panel
Roof and hood: copper glow shows in sun
Dark base: white, cream or copper numbers read cleanly; dark ones vanish.
Bold stripes, big graphics, number plates: dark quiet base from a distance
Pairs well with: cream, copper, deep teal, black.
pitfalls: Not a zellij star tile: no stars or large geometric shapes, only a fine cell net
Not crushed tile terrazzo: no coloured chips, cells are uniform
Avoid: big dark areas in the sim, busy number fonts.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 47 (low metal, like carbon or subtle flake), roughness 136 (semi-matte), clearcoat 112 (satin or weak clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: It brings its own colours, so leave BASE COLOR on the finish's own colour. Put it next to a plain zone of the opposite sheen (matte beside gloss, warm beside cool) so the colours have a calm neighbour. Avoid: big dark areas in the sim, busy number fonts.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: bold stripes, big graphics, number plates: dark quiet base from a distance; copper or cream pinstripes for contrast
Patterns to avoid: fine cells, hex, speckle, weave: noise on noise; other lace or mesh patterns
Spec overlays that work: gloss clearcoat band: reveals the rings in the sun; low copper flake: warms the rust, keep light
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
